rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The Federation Council recites that President of the Russian Federation B. N. Yeltsin ceased to exercise his powers before the end of the constitutional term as a consequence of resignation, on the basis of Article 92(2) of the Constitution.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The Federation Council schedules the early election of the President of the Russian Federation for 26 March 2000; the resolution takes effect on official publication; signed E. S. Stroev, Moscow, 5 January 2000, No. 4-SF.
